_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Template Library roadmap rendered at /extensions/template-library/roadmap. Starter Sites task status is maintained by `node scripts/gen-roadmap.mjs src/data/template-store-roadmap.json` from the extension source tree; store and content tasks have no code footprint in the plugin, so they are pinned and updated by hand.

milestones.title: Phase 1 · Decide
milestones.goal: Settle the product before building: what is sold, for how much, and where.

tasks.title: Sell templates, not prompts
tasks.detail: Unyson+ stays free; paid access to a growing library of starter sites and landing page templates, downloaded from the store and made your own by hand or with the AI Assistant.

tasks.title: No license key in Unyson+
tasks.detail: The plugin stays completely free: no key field, no locked items, no shop links. Kits are sold and downloaded on build.unysonplus.com and imported with the free Starter Sites import.

tasks.title: Plans and prices
tasks.detail: Free (3 kits + free sections), Pro (yearly, your own sites), Agency (yearly, client work, team seats), maybe Lifetime. Prices, refunds and the payment provider to confirm.

tasks.title: Name and address
tasks.detail: The store at build.unysonplus.com; the product name and where live previews are hosted to confirm.

milestones.title: Phase 2 · Starter Sites import / export (free, in the Template Library)
milestones.goal: The modern successor of the original Unyson demo importer: a light package (pages, look, header and footer, menus, forms, photos) that imports without wiping the site, and the export that makes it.

tasks.title: Package format
tasks.detail: One .zip: manifest.json (type, version, needed Unyson+ version and extensions), pages as builder export envelopes, the look (Theme Settings values and presets), header and footer, menus, forms, optional sample posts, photos.

tasks.title: Export a site as a starter site
tasks.detail: Pick the pages and include the look, header / footer, menus and forms; single pages and sections export as packages too.

tasks.title: Import with choices
tasks.detail: See what a package holds, tick what to bring over; pages are added beside existing ones (never overwritten), photos go into the Media Library, links and menus are rewired; needed extensions are offered for activation.

tasks.title: Start fresh
tasks.detail: On a new site, the kit's home page becomes the front page and its header, footer, menus and look replace the current ones.

tasks.title: Undo an import
tasks.detail: The look is applied as a Theme Settings change that can be reverted; one button removes the pages, menus and photos an import added.

tasks.title: Templates with their photos
tasks.detail: "Import template…" accepts a package with photos, not only a bare .json, and "Export with photos" gives the same back.

tasks.title: AI tools and docs
tasks.detail: Import / export abilities for the AI Assistant, the public docs page, the AI Dev Kit reference and a demo.

milestones.title: Phase 3 · The store at build.unysonplus.com
milestones.goal: A storefront built on Unyson+ and its Membership extension: browse, preview, buy, download. No license system.

tasks.title: Template catalog and live previews
tasks.detail: A kit post type with filters (business type, style, number of pages, free / Pro), a page per kit with screenshots and a live desktop / phone preview (each kit imported on its own preview subsite).

tasks.title: Plans and checkout
tasks.detail: Membership plans with PayPal / Stripe, coupons, tax and invoices; team seats for the Agency plan.

tasks.title: Downloads and update emails
tasks.detail: Kit files as members-only Protected downloads, the latest version on the account page, and an email to members when a kit is updated or a new one is out.

tasks.title: Store pages
tasks.detail: Home, Starter sites, Templates & sections, Pricing, Account (downloads, invoices, team), Help, terms, refunds and privacy.

milestones.title: Phase 4 · The first collection
milestones.goal: Twelve original kits (six starter sites, six landing pages): three free, nine Pro.

tasks.title: Kit pipeline
tasks.detail: Brief, original design, build with built-in elements and presets only, responsive / accessibility / speed checks, licensed photos with alt text, five AI-edit tests, screenshots, preview subsite, Starter Sites export.

tasks.title: Three free kits
tasks.detail: Café / restaurant and freelancer portfolio starter sites, and a SaaS launch landing page.

tasks.title: Nine Pro kits
tasks.detail: Starter sites for an agency, a clinic (with Bookings), a fitness studio (with Membership) and a real estate agent; landing pages for a coach, an event, an online course, home services and a product launch.

milestones.title: Phase 5 · Launch and grow
milestones.goal: Bring Unyson+ users to the store and keep the library growing.

tasks.title: Launch
tasks.detail: A launch offer, reels and Shorts (WordPress first, Unyson+ at the end), links from unysonplus.com and the docs.

tasks.title: Two to four new kits a month
tasks.detail: New kits and sections each month; members vote on what comes next.
